title: Temporary Bookkeeper
description:
Are you a detail-oriented and adaptable Bookkeeper looking for a hands-on role within a small business? Are you used to a stand alone position where you can support the finance function and look at ways to make efficiencies? Are you immediately available and able to work in a temporary contract for a well established business who need additional support to process a backlog of work in the first instance.

Our client, a well-established and growing manufacturer based in the Bridlington area, is seeking a temporary Bookkeeper to join their team and support them with a backlog of accounts work.

They are looking for an enthusiastic individual to take on a crucial role, providing essential financial support and contributing to the smooth operation of the business.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with solid bookkeeping experience, particularly with Sage, who is eager to become an integral part of a hands-on SME.

What the Bookkeeper job involves

You'll play a key role in managing the daily financial operations, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
- Raising customer invoices and delivery notes on a daily basis.
- Managing the invoice factoring process.
- Daily monitoring of bank accounts and cashflow.
- Payroll administration, collating employee hours each week from a clocking in system and send to payroll.
- Matching invoices and accurately allocating payments within Sage.

This is a varied and fast-paced role that would suit someone who enjoys being at the heart of an operational team, managing multiple financial priorities, and providing excellent administrative support.

Skills required

We're looking for candidates who can demonstrate a practical approach and a willingness to contribute beyond traditional bookkeeping duties. Ideal candidates will have:
- Proven experience with Sage 50 would be beneficial.
- The ability to manage and allocate payments efficiently within Sage.
- Self managed and able to work on their own initiative.
- A high degree of adaptability and flexibility to take on a range of tasks as needed.
- Previous experience in bookkeeping from a small / medium size business.

This role would suit someone who is not afraid to contribute to a busy, hands-on environment.

Other information
- Working hours are initially 10 AM to 4 PM, Monday to Friday.
- On-site car parking available.
- Own transport is essential due to the location.

title: Bookkeeper & Payroll Administrator
description:
Bookkeeper & Payroll Administrator

Hull, HU3 Permanent Part-time - 27.5 hours per week

£17.00 per hour (£24,310 per annum)

We are looking for an experienced Bookkeeper & Payroll Administrator to take responsibility for the day-to-day bookkeeping and payroll activities of an established business based in Hull.

This is a hands-on role that would suit someone with substantial practical bookkeeping and payroll experience who is comfortable managing their own workload and taking responsibility for an established finance and payroll function.

The business is currently reviewing its accounting systems and plans to move from Sage 200 to either Xero or QuickBooks before the end of the year. The successful candidate will therefore have the opportunity to be involved in the transition and help establish the new system and working processes.

The role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing the purchase and sales ledgers
- Maintaining the nominal ledger
- Processing supplier payments and customer receipts
- Completing bank reconciliations
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns
- Processing payroll using Sage 50 Payroll
- Managing PAYE/RTI submissions and associated payroll administration
- Administering workplace pension processes
- Maintaining accurate accounting records and spreadsheets
- Providing accurate financial information and reports to the Directors and external accountant as required
- Managing regular bookkeeping, payroll and statutory deadlines
- Investigating and resolving routine discrepancies and accounting queries
- Supporting the transition to a new accounting system and helping to establish effective processes within it

About you

We are looking for someone who already has the practical experience and technical knowledge needed to take ownership of the role.

You will need:
- Strong practical bookkeeping experience and a sound understanding of bookkeeping principles
- Hands-on experience of purchase, sales and nominal ledgers
- Experience of bank reconciliations, supplier payments and customer receipts
- Practical experience of VAT returns
- Good payroll experience, including PAYE/RTI and workplace pensions
- Practical experience of Xero and/or QuickBooks would be advantageous
- Practical experience of Sage 50 Payroll
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- The confidence to investigate discrepancies and resolve routine issues independently
- The judgement to recognise when something should be referred to the external accountant
- The ability to manage your own workload and meet regular deadlines

This is not a trainee or developmental position. The successful candidate will already have substantial practical bookkeeping and payroll experience. The initial handover will focus on familiarising you with our business, systems and established processes.

Hours

This is a permanent, part-time position working 27.5 hours per week.

Our preferred working pattern is Monday to Friday. However, we can offer some flexibility and would consider the 27.5 hours being worked over three or four days per week, by agreement.

Location

The role is based at our Hull branch.

There may be some initial travel to Rotherham as part of the transition arrangements, depending on the successful candidate's start date. Any such arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process.

What we offer
- £17.00 per hour
- £24,310 per annum based on 27.5 hours per week
- Permanent, part-time employment
- A regular 27.5-hour working week
- Flexibility to consider a three, four or five-day working pattern
- Responsibility for an established bookkeeping and payroll function
- The opportunity to be involved in the introduction of a new accounting system
- Support from the company's external accountant when required

Equals One is an advertising and recruitment agency working on behalf of our client to promote this vacancy. You may be contacted directly by the employer should they wish to progress your application. Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide specific feedback if your application is unsuccessful.

title: On-Site Account Administrator
description:
Job Title: On-Site Account Administrator

Location: Hull (Sunday On-Site / Monday to Thursday Office-Based)
Hours: 40 hours per week, Sunday to Thursday
Shift Pattern: Sunday 05.30 - 14.30, Monday to Thursday, 07:30 - 16:30
Salary: 28,392.00 per annum
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent Contract (Immediate Start)

About Us

Prestige Recruitment Specialists are a highly successful, multi-award-winning recruitment agency. We provide bespoke, high-volume staffing solutions directly to our major clients by operating through specialized on-site facilities. We are currently looking for a precise, organized, and data-driven On-Site Account Administrator to manage the core systems, data entry, and payroll administration for one of our busiest key accounts.

Overview of Role

Part of the dedicated Prestige On-Site Team, the On-Site Account Administrator plays a pivotal role in keeping our client's daily staffing data, payroll, and compliance records immaculate. This is a highly administrative and systems-focused role. You will take full ownership of daily data entry processing, shift logging, attendance tracking, and weekly payroll administration. Working on-site on Sundays to align with the client's weekend operations, and from our office Monday to Thursday, you will act as the administrative backbone of the account, ensuring all labor tracking, compliance data, and system records match operational requirements.

Main Duties

Payroll and Data Management
- Execute complete weekly payroll administration by collecting, verifying, and inputting time-tracker details, FOB data, and Timeware reports.
- Process and log staff absences, sickness notifications, and holiday requests into the database, calculating accurate accruals under the Working Time Directive.
- Maintain, update, and manage the internal recruitment tracking system, inputting candidate profile changes and deployment logs daily.
- Compile, format, and generate accurate daily, weekly, and monthly KPI performance spreadsheets for senior management and client review.

Compliance and General Administration
- Audit and maintain digital employee compliance folders, ensuring all records are up to date and meet UK legislation guidelines including Right to Work, AWR, and GDPR.
- Input and organize pre-planned shift rotas, worker confirmations, and database schedules to guarantee 100% data traceability.
- Handle general office administration tasks, including archiving, updating labor pool spreadsheets, and processing profile forms.
- Field administrative and wage queries from the temporary workforce, investigating discrepancies and resolving them professionally.

Communication and Team Support
- Provide administrative support to on-site coordinators, helping to process replacement labor data for reported shift absences.
- Maintain clear digital and telephone correspondence with client managers, supervisors, and Prestige Head Office regarding workforce availability.
- Attend operational briefings and planning meetings where requested to record labor forecasts and data changes.
- Support out-of-hours or on-call administration tracking where necessary to maintain account coverage.

Person Specification

Essential:
- Strong computer literacy with comprehensive experience using Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook databases.
- Exceptional data entry accuracy with a keen eye for detail and the ability to process high-volume information under strict payroll deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills to manage queries professionally.
- Absolute discretion and the ability to maintain total confidentiality when handling sensitive payroll and HR documentation.
- Highly organized with a proven ability to prioritize tasks independently within a dynamic, fast-paced team environment.

Desirable:
- Previous experience in an administration, data entry, logistics clerk, or payroll support role.
- Prior experience within a fast-moving recruitment or manufacturing administration environment is beneficial, though full system training is provided.
- A full UK driving licence and own transport are preferred due to multi-site office routing.
